what: the day's ranked clusters, in the desk's own one line, sources counted and linked (Jack, 5 October 2026)
what_a_wire_line_is: Each line is the desk's own one-line summary of a story it ranked, with its sources counted and linked. It is not a story the desk wrote or checked; only the item with a badge was checked.

items.line: Chainflip disclosed theft of 122.9 BTC and other assets totaling $12M, offering a 10% bounty for return by Nov. 24.
titles: Chainflip’s losses climb to $12 million after protocol discloses 122.9 BTC theft, offers hacker bounty

items.line: Kalshi heads to court Monday on New York AG order that the exchange claims would shut it down nationwide, contradicting AG's stated intent.
titles: Kalshi faces Monday hearing on New York order it says would shut down its exchange nationwide

items.line: Cyber bridge exploit prompted Upbit and Bithumb to halt CYBER deposits and withdrawals; unexpected token minting on Solana followed by bridge lockbox outflows.
titles: Cyber investigating suspected $1 million bridge exploit as Upbit, Bithumb freeze transfers

items.line: Bitcoin rebounded above $60K after $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto liquidations, mostly bullish positions closed in the selloff.
titles: Bitcoin rebounds above $60,000 after $1.8 billion crypto liquidation wave

items.line: UK bans crypto exchanges from making markets on their own platforms; spot Bitcoin market makers on qualifying venues exempt from principal-dealing permission.
titles: UK to ban crypto exchanges from making markets on their own platforms as Bitcoin rules change

items.line: Senate letter backs state-licensed stablecoin issuers continuing after Jan. 18, with Treasury proposal recognizing waivers for eligible federal applicants.
titles: Senators want state-licensed firms to keep issuing stablecoins after Jan. 18
